title: Define environment, configuration and secrets contract
summary: Added typed fail-fast configuration for development, test, staging and production; separated runtime/credential secrets from public YAML settings; integrated parameter/header/URL/event redaction; documented configuration inventory and rotation.

risks: Static object-storage credentials remain optional because workload identity is preferred; provider/database secrets are validated only when their environments or features require them. Initial redaction tests exposed three matching/URL issues and one Rails filter issue; all were fixed before the final passing suite.
